label: Where you are in the ALERTE journey

prereq.title: Before you start on this page

prepare.name: Prepare the exercise
prepare.desc: Build everything the drill needs: institutions, documents, mandates, agents, permissions, scenario and seats.

conduct.name: Run the exercise
conduct.desc: Watch the events arrive, the institutions decide and exchange, and step in as facilitator or as a player.

analyse.name: Analyse the results
analyse.desc: Review the gaps with their evidence, validate them, produce reports, check the logbook and replay.

institutions.title: Countries, institutions and mandates
institutions.what: Define who takes part (country, institutions), what each may or must do (mandates) and the actions a crisis requires.
institutions.next: Then add the documents the institutions rely on.

knowledge.title: Knowledge bases
knowledge.what: Import the laws, decrees and plans, check their extraction quality, then publish a version: agents only read published versions.
knowledge.next: Then create the agents that will play the institutions.

agents.title: Agents
agents.what: Create one agent per institution: mission, instructions, tools and limits (and, for a real-AI drill, a model profile).
agents.next: Then decide which knowledge base each agent may read.

access.title: Knowledge access
access.what: Tick which agent may read which knowledge base. An agent can never retrieve text from a base that is not ticked for it.
access.next: Then write or import the scenario.

scenarios.title: Scenarios
scenarios.what: Write the crisis story: ordered events (injects), who receives each one and what it requires. Run the checks.
scenarios.next: Then create an exercise from the scenario.

exercises.title: Exercises, seats and readiness
exercises.what: Create the exercise, give each institution a seat (AI agent or named human), run the readiness checks and launch.

room.title: Simulation Room
room.what: Follow the exercise live: clock, events, seats, decisions, coordination board. Pause, resume, step, add a surprise, stop.
room.next: When it has finished, review the gaps.

gaps.title: Gap analysis
gaps.what: Read each gap with its chain of evidence, then confirm, dispute or reject it. Nothing is final until a human has reviewed it.

reports.title: Reports
reports.what: Generate a versioned report from an exercise, publish it, download it, compare versions or exercises.

audit.title: Audit and replay
audit.what: Check that the logbook has not been altered, read every event, open decision traces and replay the exercise without calling any model.

evaluation.title: Evaluation and scorecard
evaluation.what: Measure the exercise (T1 to T6) and fill the 13-dimension AI Readiness scorecard. Unmeasured is shown as « not computed », never zero.

needs.institution: At least one institution (Countries, institutions and mandates).
needs.kb: At least one knowledge base (Knowledge bases).
needs.publishedKb: At least one published knowledge base: agents only read published versions.
needs.scenario: A scenario with at least one event (Scenarios).
needs.finished: A finished exercise: gaps and reports are produced from an exercise that has run.
